gen-gf-encode-sans-semi-expanded-fs-lite: Encode Sans Semi Expanded keeps its terminals open and its manner approachable, a low-contrast voice that speaks without fuss. Literata's thin-and-thick strokes want a comfortably generous body size.
gen-gf-finger-paint-roboto-slab: Roboto Slab reads precise and structured, the middle zone of each line doing most of the work. And Finger Paint's tall bodies and pen-like line make the text beneath feel all the steadier over many lines.
gen-gf-fjord-one-fs-bespoke-sans: Soft pencil-like thick-thin shifts up top, crisp openness down below. Fjord One's quiet weight variation and Bespoke Sans's generous curve openings share one refined temperament, and that agreement is what holds them together.
gen-gf-frank-ruhl-libre-fs-bespoke-sans: Sharp stroke drama in the heading, quiet openness in the text beneath. Frank Ruhl Libre does heavy-to-hairline contrast best, while Bespoke Sans does generous, uncluttered space around its curves best.
gen-gf-fustat-fs-literata: Open-mouthed curves and a line that never swells or thins: that's Fustat. Literata supplies the missing pen pressure, with wedge-shaped hints in every curve, and that give and take is what makes the two work.
gen-gf-gayathri-fs-literata: Gayathri keeps its jaws open on every curve and dips only modestly in its thin strokes, a clean, contemporary voice. Literata beside it feels warmer and bookish, with sturdier lines.
gen-gf-gentium-book-plus-fs-bespoke-sans: Bespoke Sans is sharp, with generous space at its curve ends, set against the light stroke variation of Gentium Book Plus. Serif above, sans-serif below, refined from top to bottom.
gen-gf-geologica-fs-literata: Literata reads bookish and sturdy, with a modest engraved-brass contrast. Geologica's fixed-width stencil-brush line stays plain above it, so the heading speaks simply while the serif adds the finer detail.
gen-gf-gfs-neohellenic-fs-literata: GFS Neohellenic sets round letters with rims matching the stems and narrow spacing, so every word looks solid and modern. Literata's serif lines then read softer and bookish, unhurried paragraph after paragraph.
gen-gf-glory-fs-literata: Pen-lifted curves leave loops unfinished, and tight gaps crowd Glory's letters together. Literata brings fuller stems and slimmer links, a soft cadence that carries the eye along line after line.
